title: Questions got an upgrade
summary: We built Frigade to make software easier to use. We often hear from customers that the magic of Frigade is in how much time it saves their team from the tedious, repetitive parts of support.
body_markdown:
We built Frigade to make software easier to use. We often hear from customers that the magic of Frigade is in how much time it saves their team from the tedious, repetitive parts of support.


Today we're releasing a major design upgrade to our questions page to help save your team even more time. This is one of the most heavily used parts of the Frigade dashboard, and so we see improvements to the workflow as one of the most impactful things we can do.


The new questions workflow makes it easier to quickly review large sets of user questions and leave feedback to improve the assistant. The layout is more intuitive and allows you to get more done with fewer clicks.


We hope you enjoy the improvements as much much as we've enjoyed designing them and, as always, let us know if you have any feedback on the new designs or ideas for what we build next.


Live now on the


[Questions page](https://app.frigade.ai/questions) .
